integrity: Exact structural proof supported by two independently implemented finite verifiers; the finite checks are corroborative, not a substitute for the all-parameter argument.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for connected complete bipartite graphs with both shores of size at least three and an arbitrarily deleted matching; other edge-deletion patterns are not covered. Independent mathematical validation and exhaustive priority confirmation have not been performed.
title: A matching-deletion law for dominant edge-metric generators of complete bipartite graphs
